name: The Love: PROGRAM
source:
You just wanted to...play a normal game in a Windows 3.1 computer.

But...you realize it's just a crappy game and you uninstalled it

But you got a really...really...weird program...

[Adapted from [url=https://armend-xd.itch.io/the-love-program]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你只想…在Windows 3.1计算机上玩普通游戏。

但是……你意识到这只是一个蹩脚的游戏，然后你卸载了它

但你有一个非常…非常…奇怪的程序…

[改编自 [url=https://armend-xd.itch.io/the-love-program]Itch.io[/url]]
